hero.eyebrow: A more thoughtful way to find your next role
hero.body: CareerHub connects every academic specialization with employers who value its strengths — with clear guidance at every step.
hero.keywordPlaceholder: Search a job title, company, or skill
hero.trustNote: For every field of study, from engineering to the humanities.
hero.counterLabel: steps from your background to your next opportunity
hero.previewBody: Bring your experience into view and discover roles that make sense for where you want to go.

workflow.body: From your first CV draft to the interview stage, CareerHub keeps your next move clear and focused.
workflow.stepOneBody: Upload a PDF or DOCX for free, or create an ATS-ready academic resume from scratch.
workflow.stepTwoBody: AI compares your academic specialization and experience with current verified roles.
workflow.stepThreeBody: See missing skills and a practical three-step roadmap toward a 90%+ fit.
workflow.stepFourBody: Apply with match feedback and follow your application and interview progress.

stories.title: They landed in weeks, not semesters.
